Messages.Author: Whisker
Messages.Body:
Hello all,
Because of family reasons I have not been able play any VtES recently, but I have been amusing myself by coming up with convoluted ideas for decks. Here one of my latest demented plots, use Sylvester Simms special as an actual oust mechanish.

Make sylvester go torpor several times each turn, to remove pool from whole table, bleed hard enough to make sure your prey is first to fall and bloat so you don't die yourself. That's the basic premise. I'd like to see your take on this. Below is my first draft to use as starting point, though it's still missing the bloat / survival part.

Cheers, let your inner Malkavians loose.

Sylvester Simms
ani dom pre AUS OBF
Malkavian
Capacity: 8
Group: 1
Camarilla primogen: If Sylvester goes into torpor, each Methuselah burns 1 pool.

Deck Name: Sylvester Simms torpor machine v0.1
Author: Mikko Moisander
Description:
Put fortitude on Sylvester. Bleed, hunt or do table actions and each time play daring the dawn to sent sylvester in torpor netting damage to whole table. Repeat as many times as you can rescue sylvester and untap him. Hopefully your actions hurt your prey faster than other players, you included.

Messages.Author: Killiam
Messages.Body:
I understand that Baltimore Purge (BP) not only puts you in torpor, but creates a bunch of table actions, some of which can give you blood.

..And if you are using BP and have fortitude on Sylvester (SS), Renewed Vigor is a good add. SS can use it at outferior to bounce right back from torpor during untap, and if you have a wingman with OBE, you can use it to fill him, which you will likely need to do if he is traveling in and out of torpor so much. I see you have one in your deck already; that’s a start!

Cheers!

-Killiam

Oh, and Mummify also unlocks you in its S:CE... and Sylvester Simms has both

and

. Yes, you can use Fast Reaction or Hidden Lurker as a threat.

They block any of your minions -- or take any actions you feel obliged to block -- Sylvester threatens to show up, S:CE and unlock, and throw himself into torpor again. (And for Hidden Lurker, once rescued afterwards Simms is unlocked to do it all over again.)
